The Brown University Foraminiferal Data Base (BFD) (1999) in Publishing Network for Geoscientific and Environmental Data is authored by Warren L Prell, Anthony J. Martin and Cullen, James L. Topics: Base (topology), Mathematics and Mathematical analysis.

19 citations (OpenAlex). Citations peaked in 2023 with 67 citing works. Citing venues include Global Biodiversity Information Facility, Palaeogeography Palaeoclimatology Palaeoecology and Geochemistry Geophysics Geosystems.
